logistics.format: Multiple Choice / Multiple Response, Pearson VUE in-person or OnVUE online proctored

recommended_certs.rationale: CSC で開発実装の安全コーディングを、CSSP で SDLC 全体のセキュアプラクティスを補完する。

plus.note: Covers Python and JavaScript across multiple platforms; not tied to a specific framework or vendor.

minus.note: No coding-execution component, despite developer audience.

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced associate: 2, foundational: 1. The ordered median is associate. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: Vendor-neutral secure coding and the recorded developer-role alignment support associate knowledge; no coding execution, no required experience and limited recognition constrain its delivery signal.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: Recorded DoD 8140 approval and vendor-neutral secure-coding scope make this a useful associate developer screen. Zero experience and no coding-execution component prevent interpreting the exam as proof of professional code-review delivery.

alex-novak.rationale: Vendor-neutral Python and JavaScript secure-coding coverage is useful technical groundwork. With zero experience required and explicitly no code-execution assessment, I place it below the recorded associate hints.
